// diagnostic

L0534

`{group}` copies the whole group out of `{map}` and stores it back

What

`{group}` copies the whole group out of `{map}` and stores it back

Why

`{group}` still shares the entry's buffer when it is written, so the write first copies the whole group, and storing it back drops the Map's old copy; in a loop that is quadratic. Only a block that pushes plain values onto a group taken with an empty List fallback moves the group out of the Map without a copy

Fix

Grow the entry in place: `if !{map}.has_key({key}) -> {map}[{key}] = {fallback}`, then `{map}[{key}].{write}(…)`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0534: tests/ui_lint/map_group_round_trip.warn.

Warning [jet.MapGroupRoundTrip]: `group` copies the whole group out of `groups` and stores it back
  --> tests/ui_lint/map_group_round_trip.jet:10:9
    |
 10 |         group := groups.get(p.dept) ?? [Person]{}
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `group` still shares the entry's buffer when it is written, so the write first copies the whole group, and storing it back drops the Map's old copy; in a loop that is quadratic. Only a block that pushes plain values onto a group taken with an empty List fallback moves the group out of the Map without a copy
 Fix: Grow the entry in place: `if !groups.has_key(p.dept) -> groups[p.dept] = [Person]{}`, then `groups[p.dept].insert(…)`

 56 |         group := titled.get(p.dept) ?? ["header"]
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `group` still shares the entry's buffer when it is written, so the write first copies the whole group, and storing it back drops the Map's old copy; in a loop that is quadratic. Only a block that pushes plain values onto a group taken with an empty List fallback moves the group out of the Map without a copy
 Fix: Grow the entry in place: `if !titled.has_key(p.dept) -> titled[p.dept] = ["header"]`, then `titled[p.dept].push(…)`
